svg.aria-label: Four steps. Peer A sends a search request to its neighbors B, C, D and E with a hop limit of 3. Each neighbor forwards the request to its own neighbors with the hop limit decremented to 2. The request spreads through many peers until the hop limit reaches 0 or a peer with the content is found. Peer F, which has the content, sends a response back to Peer A along the reverse path through the peer that forwarded the request
svg.text: How flooding works in an unstructured P2P network
A search spreads from neighbor to neighbor until its hop limit runs out or a peer with the content answers.
